svg.title: The app calls one agent
svg.desc: A signed-in user's browser gets a Foundry token through the web app's single-page sign-in registration. The Azure Container Apps web app's proxy forwards only that token and the question to the Foundry hosted agent's Responses endpoint, and Foundry keeps each user's conversations private. The agent's project toolbox queries the bound ontology through Fabric IQ as that user and retrieves document evidence from the Foundry IQ knowledge base with the project's managed identity, so documents are not trimmed per user. The app holds no credential or shared token, and deployment consent is a separate boundary. Prove the fresh challenge, live facts, a cited document and second-user denial and isolation separately; other users need an operator-granted role. Cold sessions and live ontology queries can take a minute.

g.text: The app forwards the signed-in user's own token; Fabric IQ runs as that user.
Sign in once; the browser gets a Foundry token.
No app credential or shared token
Deployment consent is a different boundary.
Answers return through the same agent and proxy.
Fabric IQ stays on the user's own token.
Answers come only from the two tools.
Never replace denied live facts with files.
Fresh challenge, live facts, cited document.
Prove denial + isolation with a second user.
Other users need an operator-granted role.
Cold sessions and live ontology queries can take a minute; the proxy waits up to 220 s.
Documents use the project identity: anyone who can invoke the agent can read them.
